verdict.rationale: There is no explicit no-training policy or opt-out in the evidence. However, Typesense is open source and can be downloaded and run locally or on any server you control instead of Typesense Cloud, which indirectly keeps data out of the vendor's hands. Missing for 10: an explicit data-use/no-AI-training policy for Typesense Cloud, documented opt-out controls, clarity on how data sent to third-party LLM integrations is handled, and independent corroboration.
